items.title: Roger Kellaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: Bartok lover. ... I never spent enough time with him. I adored him.

ctx.x: I see. Yeah he had quite a success with that, the first one, and he really made his name, didn’t he?
Um hum. Incredible talent. Bartok lover.
